query: INSERT INTO import_run_item (org_id, run_id, locator, ordinal, state, product_id, failure_detail, read_at, settled_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'failed', $5, $6, $7, $7) ON CONFLICT (org_id, run_id, locator) DO UPDATE SET state = 'failed', failure_detail = EXCLUDED.failure_detail, skip_reason = NULL, settled_at = EXCLUDED.settled_at
